subject: game-production-runner portable cold-history tier export and restore

claims.claim: Tier planning is read-only and obeys independent history, package, aggregate, and candidate bounds.
claims.pass_condition: Planning leaves an absent tier root absent; threshold and byte ceilings yield NO_CHANGES or HELD with no candidate.
claims.primary_surface: native core assertions over disposable cache and tier roots
claims.counterevidence: any tier file appears or an over-budget candidate becomes applicable
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: CLI plan output plus filesystem absence
claims.observed_evidence: core and CLI focused suites pass deletion-free plan, threshold, per-package, aggregate, and no-root assertions
claims.named_seam: candidate-count deferral is contract-checked; the named fixture contains one eligible owner

claims.claim: Only an exact root-bound proposal can write a tier package.
claims.pass_condition: Wrong approval, copied source root, changed source history, or overlapping tier root writes nothing.
claims.counterevidence: a package root is created after any refused application
claims.observed_evidence: wrong approval, copied-root, post-plan history, and overlap assertions pass
claims.named_seam: local owner digests are continuity evidence, not authentication

claims.claim: Export preserves every source archive file and its deep-audit meaning.
claims.pass_condition: Application reports zero removals and source archive summaries are identical before and after export.
claims.counterevidence: missing source file, changed storage snapshot, or nonzero source removal
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: contract and CLI absence of semantic-deletion route
claims.observed_evidence: source_files_removed is zero and exact source anchor arrays compare equal
claims.named_seam: history is duplicated, so source storage growth is not solved

claims.claim: The content-addressed package survives interruption and exposes mutation.
claims.pass_condition: A partial exact payload resumes to COMPLETE; same-size mutation yields REVIEW_REQUIRED and cannot restore.
claims.primary_surface: partial-publication replay and same-size corruption adversaries
claims.counterevidence: partial bytes are overwritten, corruption audits COMPLETE, or corrupt restore writes a target
claims.observed_evidence: partial export recovers, corruption holds, and fresh child package audit passes
claims.named_seam: content addressing detects mutation but is not an immutable-storage substrate

claims.claim: Exact approved restore into a fresh root reconstructs the same full archive summary.
claims.pass_condition: Package approval is exact, anchor is published last, target deep audit and discovery match the manifest source summary, and restart repeats the proof.
claims.primary_surface: fresh-root restore plus native deep audit
claims.counterevidence: wrong approval creates target state, target accepts extra files, or any source/target summary field differs
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: fresh child process reopens package and target
claims.observed_evidence: wrong approval and collision refuse; fresh and partial restore pass; fresh child observes 33 history events
claims.named_seam: fresh local process is not a fresh machine or remote receiver

claims.claim: Tiering claims neither external immutability nor semantic-retention authority.
claims.pass_condition: All manifests and receipts keep external immutability and source deletion false; contracts refuse both claims.
claims.primary_surface: runtime receipt assertions and parsed module contracts
claims.counterevidence: any route deletes source history or labels a local folder immutable
claims.observed_evidence: runtime, schema, CLI, manifest, contract, and gap report agree on the boundary
claims.named_seam: external durable substrate and user-owned semantic retention remain open gaps
